warnings.outside_D_ingress: A D journal cannot account for unseen/discarded external incoming messages. Independently held ingress witness required.
warnings.durability: Source only returns a new immutable tuple; it cannot commit a transaction or prove storage survived a crash.
warnings.early_failure: If journal is invalid, source reports D_READ_JOURNAL_UNPROVEN without claiming an appended row. A real D must fail closed and independent ingress must record the loss.
warnings.historic_key: Old signed token requires independently enrolled issuance-time key/snapshot; key retirement is not automatic invalidity and a compromised key may demand source-timestamp/custody adjudication.
warnings.caller_auth: Authentic original token != current receipt-read authority. Read-rights must be independently scoped and revokeable.
warnings.A0_and_D: This source does not reauthorize A0 commitment or effects; the previous v0.3/v0.4 BLOCK remains.
warnings.known_gap: RA17 shows copied/forged in-memory journal has valid shape. Real D store ownership is not established.
warnings.no_privileged_read: Every model return has permit_historical_lookup=false, permit_receipt_release=false, permit_new_effect=false, durable_commit_proven=false.
